title: See it. Say it. Make it safer.
text: Report hazards and near misses early. Small interventions prevent bigger incidents.

title: Employee Assistance is confidential.
text: Support is available when work or life feels difficult. Open Employee Assistance from the noticeboard for current contact details.

title: Know where to go before you need to.
text: Check the Emergency Control Map and familiarise yourself with exits, emergency equipment and assembly areas.
